label: WP29 Guidelines on Data Protection Officers (WP243 rev.01) — EU-authoritative; persuasive only in the UK (ICO guidance is aligned)
citation: Article 29 Working Party WP243 rev.01 (5 April 2017), endorsed by EDPB
body: • "Core activities" = key operations to achieve the controller's goals, not ancillary functions (HR, payroll, IT support).
• "Large scale" considered against: (i) number of subjects (absolute or as a share of population), (ii) volume of data + scope, (iii) duration / permanence of processing, (iv) geographic extent.

• "Regular and systematic monitoring" — explicitly includes all forms of tracking and profiling on the internet, including for behavioural-advertising purposes. Online behavioural advertisers will almost always meet this test.
• Examples: hospital (large-scale special category) → DPO required; insurance/banks → DPO required; loyalty programme operators → likely required; small clinic → not required.
• DPO independence: no instructions; reports to highest management level; cannot be dismissed for performing tasks; no conflict of interest (codified by CJEU C-453/21 X-FAB).
• Voluntary DPO designations are still subject to Arts. 38–39 — call them something else if you want to avoid the framework.
